criteria.question: does phase-locked proprioceptive drive from the wing and haltere campaniform afferents put the wing motor neurons in their measured ranges, and does a DNg02 descending command bring DLMn c-f in?

protocol.drive: a fraction LOAD of the campaniform afferents (ADMN, DMetaN; sorted by bodyId) recruited per seed, one spike per wingbeat cycle at a uniform random phase with gaussian jitter (an 8 mV kick into each afferent), after 200 ms of settling
protocol.anchor_rule: smallest load with mean DVMn 1a-c (across recruitment draws) in 2-12 Hz; if none, the load nearest 6 Hz, flagged
protocol.null: rewire_null(edges, seed=0) at the anchor load, same recruitment seeds
protocol.closed_loop: from the anchor load, load = clip(0.5 + 0.5 * power MN rate / 6 Hz, 0.05, 1) every 50 ms (reported)
protocol.stage2_rule: DNg02 subtypes (resolved from the data) at each swept rate, at the anchor load; chosen rate: the smallest with mean DLMn c-f and mean DVMn 1a-c both in 2-12 Hz
protocol.scoring: per draw (stats.per_draw, need 0.8): each recruitment seed is one draw; PASS if ceil(0.8 n) of the n seeds are in band, FAIL if at most floor(0.2 n), else UNRESOLVED

L1a_DVMn_2_to_12_hz.rule: DVMn 1a-c fires 2-12 Hz at the anchor load, scored per recruitment seed

L1b_DLMn_cf_2_to_12_hz.rule: DLMn c-f fires 2-12 Hz at the anchor load, scored per recruitment seed

L2_b1_0.5_to_1.2_spikes_per_wingbeat.rule: b1 MN fires 0.5-1.2 spikes per wingbeat (its rate in Hz within 0.5 and 1.2 x 202.0) at the anchor load, scored per recruitment seed

L3_leg_mn_not_entrained.condition: scored only if some neuron matches the leg motor neuron pattern; otherwise UNRESOLVED (stats.unresolved, no band), since the leg rate is undefined
L3_leg_mn_not_entrained.rule: leg motor neurons fire below 0.1 spikes per wingbeat (0.1 x 202.0 Hz) at the anchor load, scored per recruitment seed (the point check is strict, per_draw's edge is inclusive)

L4_steering_specific_vs_null.condition: scored only if the rewired null fires a spike outside the driven afferents (summed over the draws); otherwise UNRESOLVED (stats.unresolved, no band), since a silent null cannot test wiring specificity
L4_steering_specific_vs_null.rule: real steering MN rate / max(null steering MN rate, 0.2 Hz) at least 5, paired by recruitment seed at the anchor load (the point check is strict, per_draw's edge is inclusive)

L5_DLMn_cf_2_to_12_hz_with_DNg02.rule: some swept DNg02 rate puts DLMn c-f (first band) and DVMn 1a-c (second band) both in 2-12 Hz, each scored per recruitment seed: any of the rates, each rate the conjunction of its two parts

L6_DVMn_still_in_band_with_DNg02.rule: reported, not scored: as coded, L6 is true exactly when L5 is (the DNg02 rule already requires DVMn in band), so scoring both would count one measurement twice

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 15 spikes per loom (9.7 on average on the strongest-gain quartile).
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
